title: The maximum Laplacian ratio of a tree: a complete answer to a question of Brualdi and Goldwasser, kernel-checked in Lean
description: Lean 4 formalization, certificate generators and paper answering a question of Brualdi and Goldwasser (1984): for every n >= 4 the tree maximizing per L(T)/prod deg(v) is an explicit spider of cherry arms, and the maximum grows exactly like ((621/64)^(1/11))^n. Kernel-checked in Lean 4 with Mathlib; standard axioms only. Not yet refereed.
